headline: San Antonio Truckers End Strike After Securing 8% Tariff Increase
summary: Truckers in San Antonio ended a nine-day strike after reaching an agreement with cargo generators for an 8% increase in transport tariffs, clearing port deposits and accumulated container backlogs.
why: Freight transport tariffs directly impact supply chain costs and logistics operations for international trade, particularly in agricultural exports.

impacts.name: Freight Transport and Logistics
impacts.why: An 8% tariff increase directly raises revenues for transport providers in the region.
